name: Day 17 — 準備出差 Trip Prep

qs.q: Where is the narrator going next month?
Why does he want to bring his own towel?
ch: The hotel's towels are too small

qs.q: What does the wife say at the end?
ch: It's only two days — don't bring too much

gram.t: 幫我 + verb — do it for me
gram.d: 幫 + person + verb = do the action for their benefit: 幫我拿毛巾 grab me a towel, 幫我看一下 take a look for me, 幫你訂 I'll book it for you. The politest little workhorse in daily Mandarin — you'll use it ten times a day.

readings.title: 訂票跟訂房 Tickets and Rooms

qs.q: What are the trip dates?
What did he buy first?
Why a double room?

gram.t: 先…再… — first this, then that
gram.d: Sequence two actions: 先買車票，再訂飯店。 Tickets first, hotel second. 先吃飯再說 eat first, talk later. Planning-speak essential — chain it: 先…然後…最後… for full itineraries.

readings.title: 故事④：帳本 Story ④: The Ledger

qs.q: Who runs the night-market noodle stall now?
How did the noodles taste?
ch: Exactly the same as the typhoon-night bowl

qs.q: What is written on the ledger's last page?
ch: One bowl, unpaid — a fresh entry

gram.d: A 跟 B 一樣 = A is the same as B: 味道跟那碗一樣 the taste is the same as that bowl. Add the quality: 跟以前一樣好吃 as delicious as before. Negate: 跟以前不一樣 — not like it used to be. Comparison bedrock.

readings.title: 差旅規定 Travel Expense Rules

qs.q: What can be expensed on the trip?
What must be printed on invoices?
ch: The company's unified tax ID (統編)

qs.q: When must the itemized expense list be filled out?

gram.d: 以便 + desired outcome: 請填好明細，以便會計快速處理。 Fill it out so accounting can process it fast. Formal-memo glue: the front half is the request, 以便 introduces who benefits and how. Cousin of 為了, but 以便 trails the action instead of leading it.

readings.title: 簽約前的備忘錄 The Pre-Signing Memo

qs.q: What did both sides decide to sign before the contract?
What three things does the memo confirm first?
ch: Both sides' rights, expected benefits, and future scope

qs.q: What is the boss's stated goal?
ch: Creating a win-win for a long, steady partnership

gram.d: 針對 + topic points the whole sentence at its target: 針對投資，備忘錄先確認權益。 Regarding the investment, the memo first confirms rights. Meetings and news both open points this way — 針對這個問題… is the professional 'as for this issue'.

dict.zh: 幫我拿一條毛巾。
dict.py: Bāng wǒ ná yì tiáo máojīn.
dict.en: Grab me a towel.

dict.zh: 牙刷跟牙膏都放進去了。
dict.py: Yáshuā gēn yágāo dōu fàng jìnqù le.
dict.en: The toothbrush and toothpaste are packed.

dict.zh: 行李箱不大，可是放得下。
dict.py: Xínglǐxiāng bú dà, kěshì fàng de xià.
dict.en: The suitcase isn't big, but everything fits.

dict.zh: 兩天而已，不要帶太多。
dict.py: Liǎng tiān éryǐ, búyào dài tài duō.
dict.en: It's only two days — don't bring too much.

dict.zh: 充電器帶了嗎？
dict.py: Chōngdiànqì dài le ma?
dict.en: Did you pack the charger?

pass.zh: 老公，行李我幫你收好了。牙刷、牙膏、毛巾都在裡面。充電器我放在行李箱的前面，很好找。到高雄的時候，打電話給我喔！

qs.q: Where did she put the charger?
ch: In the front of the suitcase

qs.q: What should he do upon arriving in Kaohsiung?

dict.zh: 我要買兩張高鐵的來回票。
dict.py: Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng zhāng gāotiě de láihuípiào.
dict.en: I'd like two round-trip HSR tickets.

dict.zh: 我選了靠窗的位子。
dict.py: Wǒ xuǎn le kàochuāng de wèizi.
dict.en: I picked window seats.

dict.zh: 先買車票，再訂飯店。
dict.py: Xiān mǎi chēpiào, zài dìng fàndiàn.
dict.en: Tickets first, then the hotel.

dict.zh: 我們訂一間雙人房。
dict.py: Wǒmen dìng yì jiān shuāngrénfáng.
dict.en: We're booking a double room.

dict.zh: 有早餐的最好！
dict.py: Yǒu zǎocān de zuì hǎo!
dict.en: One with breakfast is ideal!

pass.zh: 欸，車票買好了嗎？九號早上八點半的車，靠窗！飯店我看了三家，有一家有早餐，離高鐵站走路五分鐘，我把連結傳給你，你看一下！

qs.q: What time is the train on the ninth?
What's special about the hotel he found?
ch: Breakfast included, five minutes' walk from the HSR station

dict.zh: 請問還有雙人房嗎？
dict.py: Qǐngwèn hái yǒu shuāngrénfáng ma?
dict.en: Do you still have double rooms?

dict.zh: 櫃檯在一樓，二十四小時都有人。
dict.py: Guìtái zài yī lóu, èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu rén.
dict.en: The front desk is on the first floor, staffed 24 hours.

dict.zh: 今天可以免費幫您升等。
dict.py: Jīntiān kěyǐ miǎnfèi bāng nín shēngděng.
dict.en: Today we can upgrade you for free.

dict.zh: 高鐵票要用搶的，早點買！
dict.py: Gāotiě piào yào yòng qiǎng de, zǎodiǎn mǎi!
dict.en: HSR tickets go fast — buy early!

dict.zh: 退房以後，行李可以放櫃檯。
dict.py: Tuìfáng yǐhòu, xínglǐ kěyǐ fàng guìtái.
dict.en: After checkout, you can leave luggage at the front desk.

pass.zh: 您好，這裡是大港飯店。您訂的是九月九號一晚，雙人房含早餐。那天剛好有活動，如果您早一點到，櫃檯可以免費幫您升等到高樓層的房間，看得到港口喔！

qs.q: What does the booking include?
ch: One night, double room with breakfast

qs.q: What's the free upgrade offer?
ch: A high-floor room with a harbor view

dict.zh: 出差申請已經核准了。
dict.py: Chūchāi shēnqǐng yǐjīng hézhǔn le.
dict.en: The business-trip application is approved.

dict.zh: 每一筆費用都要有收據。
dict.py: Měi yì bǐ fèiyòng dōu yào yǒu shōujù.
dict.en: Every expense needs a receipt.

dict.zh: 發票上要打公司的統編。
dict.py: Fāpiào shàng yào dǎ gōngsī de tǒngbiān.
dict.en: Invoices must carry the company's tax ID.

dict.zh: 回來一週內要填費用明細。
dict.py: Huílái yì zhōu nèi yào tián fèiyòng míngxì.
dict.en: File the itemized expenses within a week of returning.

dict.zh: 差旅的規定，請大家看一下。
dict.py: Chāilǚ de guīdìng, qǐng dàjiā kàn yíxià.
dict.en: Please review the travel regulations.

pass.zh: 提醒一下出差的兩位：吃飯、坐車的發票，記得都要打統編，號碼我傳到群組了。回來以後把明細填一填，附上收據，我核准了就送會計，這樣月底前就能下來。

qs.q: What was sent to the group chat?
What happens after the itemized list is approved?
ch: It goes to accounting for payment before month's end

dict.zh: 雙方決定先簽一份備忘錄。
dict.py: Shuāngfāng juédìng xiān qiān yí fèn bèiwànglù.
dict.en: Both sides decided to first sign a memorandum.

dict.zh: 備忘錄會先確認雙方的權益。
dict.py: Bèiwànglù huì xiān quèrèn shuāngfāng de quányì.
dict.en: The MOU first confirms both sides' rights and interests.

dict.zh: 預期的效益要寫清楚。
dict.py: Yùqí de xiàoyì yào xiě qīngchǔ.
dict.en: The expected benefits must be written clearly.

dict.zh: 針對投資的部分，下週再談。
dict.py: Zhēnduì tóuzī de bùfèn, xià zhōu zài tán.
dict.en: As for the investment portion, talks continue next week.

dict.zh: 我們的目標是創造雙贏。
dict.py: Wǒmen de mùbiāo shì chuàngzào shuāngyíng.
dict.en: Our goal is to create a win-win.

pass.zh: 會議重點整理：第一，備忘錄下週三前完成草稿，法務先看過。第二，針對對方增加投資的想法，我們歡迎，但是權益跟範圍要先談清楚。第三，簽約當天的流程，由小美統整。原則只有一個：雙贏，才走得遠。

qs.q: When must the MOU draft be done?
ch: By next Wednesday, reviewed by legal first

qs.q: What is the one stated principle?
ch: Win-win is what goes the distance

scenarios.intro: The suitcase is open on the bed and your wife is quality-controlling your packing decisions. She is right about everything.

them.zh: 你的牙刷跟牙膏，我放進去了！
them.py: Nǐ de yáshuā gēn yágāo, wǒ fàng jìnqù le!
them.en: I packed your toothbrush and toothpaste!

turns.task: Thank her — and ask her to grab you a towel too.

ans.zh: 謝謝老婆！再幫我拿一條毛巾。
ans.py: Xièxiè lǎopó! Zài bāng wǒ ná yì tiáo máojīn.
ans.en: Thanks, honey! Grab me a towel too.

them.zh: 毛巾好了。衣服你要帶幾件？
them.py: Máojīn hǎo le. Yīfú nǐ yào dài jǐ jiàn?
them.en: Towel's in. How many shirts are you bringing?

turns.task: Two days — three shirts is enough.

ans.zh: 兩天而已，三件就夠了。
ans.py: Liǎng tiān éryǐ, sān jiàn jiù gòu le.
ans.en: Just two days — three is enough.

them.zh: 行李箱會不會太小？
them.py: Xínglǐxiāng huì bú huì tài xiǎo?
them.en: Is the suitcase too small?

turns.task: It's fine — everything fits.

ans.zh: 不會，東西不多，放得下。
ans.py: Bú huì, dōngxi bù duō, fàng de xià.
ans.en: It's fine — not much stuff, it all fits.

them.zh: 充電器！你每次都忘記充電器！
them.py: Chōngdiànqì! Nǐ měi cì dōu wàngjì chōngdiànqì!
them.en: The charger! You ALWAYS forget the charger!

turns.task: Busted. Ask her to put it in the front of the suitcase.

ans.zh: 哈哈，對！幫我放在行李箱的前面。
ans.py: Hāhā, duì! Bāng wǒ fàng zài xínglǐxiāng de qiánmiàn.
ans.en: Haha, true! Put it in the front of the suitcase for me.

them.zh: 好了！到高雄要打電話給我喔！
them.py: Hǎo le! Dào Gāoxióng yào dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ ō!
them.en: Done! Call me when you get to Kaohsiung!

turns.task: Promise — the moment you arrive.

ans.zh: 一定！我一到就打給你！
ans.py: Yídìng! Wǒ yí dào jiù dǎ gěi nǐ!
ans.en: Promise! The moment I arrive, I'll call!

scenarios.intro: Booking day. Xiao Chen has the app open and strong seat preferences. Coordinate before the good trains vanish.

them.zh: 欸，九號的高鐵票開賣了！要買哪一班？
them.py: Éi, jiǔ hào de gāotiě piào kāimài le! Yào mǎi nǎ yì bān?
them.en: Hey, tickets for the ninth are on sale! Which train?

turns.task: The 8:30 AM train — and buy round-trip directly.

ans.zh: 買早上八點半的，直接買來回票！
ans.py: Mǎi zǎoshàng bā diǎn bàn de, zhíjiē mǎi láihuípiào!
ans.en: The 8:30 AM one — get round-trip tickets directly!

them.zh: 好！位子呢？你要靠窗還是走道？
them.py: Hǎo! Wèizi ne? Nǐ yào kàochuāng háishì zǒudào?
them.en: On it! Seats? Window or aisle?

turns.task: Window — you want to see the scenery.

ans.zh: 我要靠窗的，想看風景。
ans.py: Wǒ yào kàochuāng de, xiǎng kàn fēngjǐng.
ans.en: Window for me — I want to watch the scenery.

them.zh: 買好了！那飯店呢？訂了沒？
them.py: Mǎi hǎo le! Nà fàndiàn ne? Dìng le méi?
them.en: Done! And the hotel? Booked yet?

turns.task: Tonight — tickets first, hotel second; you found one with breakfast.

ans.zh: 今天晚上訂。先買車票再訂房，我找到一家有早餐的！
ans.py: Jīntiān wǎnshàng dìng. Xiān mǎi chēpiào zài dìngfáng, wǒ zhǎodào yì jiā yǒu zǎocān de!
ans.en: Tonight. Tickets first, room second — I found one with breakfast!

them.zh: 讚！我們住一間雙人房，公司比較省錢。
them.py: Zàn! Wǒmen zhù yì jiān shuāngrénfáng, gōngsī bǐjiào shěngqián.
them.en: Nice! We'll share a double room — saves the company money.

turns.task: Fine — but warn him: no snoring!

ans.zh: 可以，可是你不能打呼喔！
ans.py: Kěyǐ, kěshì nǐ bùnéng dǎhū ō!
ans.en: Fine — but no snoring!

them.zh: 哈哈，我不打呼啦！那就都訂好了！
them.py: Hāhā, wǒ bù dǎhū la! Nà jiù dōu dìng hǎo le!
them.en: Haha, I don't snore! Then we're all booked!

turns.task: Perfect — Kaohsiung, here we come.

ans.zh: 太好了，高雄我們來了！
ans.py: Tài hǎo le, Gāoxióng wǒmen lái le!
ans.en: Perfect — Kaohsiung, here we come!

scenarios.intro: One phone call to confirm the booking, sniff out the upgrade, and lock down breakfast times. Hotel Mandarin — the OPI classic.

them.zh: 大港飯店您好，很高興為您服務！
them.py: Dàgǎng Fàndiàn nín hǎo, hěn gāoxìng wèi nín fúwù!
them.en: Dagang Hotel, how may I help you?

turns.task: You booked a double room for Sept 9 — confirm the reservation.

ans.zh: 您好，我訂了九月九號的雙人房，想確認一下訂房。
ans.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ dìng le jiǔ yuè jiǔ hào de shuāngrénfáng, xiǎng quèrèn yíxià dìngfáng.
ans.en: Hello — I booked a double room for September ninth and would like to confirm the reservation.

them.zh: 找到了，一晚含早餐。那天有活動，早點到的話，櫃檯可以免費幫您升等喔！
them.py: Zhǎodào le, yì wǎn hán zǎocān. Nà tiān yǒu huódòng, zǎodiǎn dào dehuà, guìtái kěyǐ miǎnfèi bāng nín shēngděng ō!
them.en: Found it — one night with breakfast. There's a promo that day: arrive early and the desk can upgrade you free!

turns.task: Excellent — ask what time you can arrive for the upgrade.

ans.zh: 太好了！請問幾點以前到，可以升等？
ans.py: Tài hǎo le! Qǐngwèn jǐ diǎn yǐqián dào, kěyǐ shēngděng?
ans.en: Wonderful! By what time should we arrive for the upgrade?

them.zh: 下午三點以前到櫃檯就可以。請問大概幾點到呢？
them.py: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǐqián dào guìtái jiù kěyǐ. Qǐngwèn dàgài jǐ diǎn dào ne?
them.en: Just reach the desk before 3 PM. About when will you arrive?

turns.task: Around 10:30 AM — you'll drop luggage first, since the meeting is at noon.

ans.zh: 大概十點半。我們先把行李放櫃檯，因為中午有會議。
ans.py: Dàgài shí diǎn bàn. Wǒmen xiān bǎ xínglǐ fàng guìtái, yīnwèi zhōngwǔ yǒu huìyì.
ans.en: Around ten thirty. We'll leave our luggage at the desk first — we have a meeting at noon.

them.zh: 沒問題！早餐是六點半到十點，在二樓。
them.py: Méi wèntí! Zǎocān shì liù diǎn bàn dào shí diǎn, zài èr lóu.
them.en: No problem! Breakfast is 6:30 to 10:00 on the second floor.

turns.task: Got it — one more thing: you need an invoice with a company tax ID for the room.

ans.zh: 了解。對了，房費的發票要打公司的統編，可以嗎？
ans.py: Liǎojiě. Duìle, fángfèi de fāpiào yào dǎ gōngsī de tǒngbiān, kěyǐ ma?
ans.en: Got it. One more thing — the room invoice needs our company tax ID. Is that OK?

them.zh: 可以的，退房的時候把號碼給櫃檯就好。還有其他需要嗎？
them.py: Kěyǐ de, tuìfáng de shíhòu bǎ hàomǎ gěi guìtái jiù hǎo. Hái yǒu qítā xūyào ma?
them.en: Certainly — just give the number at checkout. Anything else?

turns.task: That's all — thank them, see you on the ninth.

ans.zh: 沒有了，謝謝您，九號見！
ans.py: Méiyǒu le, xièxiè nín, jiǔ hào jiàn!
ans.en: That's everything — thank you, see you on the ninth!

scenarios.intro: Xiaomei has processed a thousand expense reports and rejected half of them. Learn her rules and your reimbursement arrives before month's end.

them.zh: 出差核准了喔！報帳的規定你清楚嗎？
them.py: Chūchāi hézhǔn le ō! Bàozhàng de guīdìng nǐ qīngchǔ ma?
them.en: Your trip's approved! Are you clear on the expense rules?

turns.task: Mostly — confirm: HSR, hotel, and meals can all be expensed?

ans.zh: 大概清楚。確認一下：高鐵、飯店跟餐費都可以報帳，對嗎？
ans.py: Dàgài qīngchǔ. Quèrèn yíxià: gāotiě, fàndiàn gēn cānfèi dōu kěyǐ bàozhàng, duì ma?
ans.en: Mostly. To confirm — HSR, hotel, and meals can all be expensed, right?

them.zh: 對，但是每一筆都要有收據或發票，缺一張就少報一筆。
them.py: Duì, dànshì měi yì bǐ dōu yào yǒu shōujù huò fāpiào, quē yì zhāng jiù shǎo bào yì bǐ.
them.en: Right — but every item needs a receipt or invoice. Missing one means one less claim.

turns.task: Understood — and every invoice gets the company tax ID printed on it.

ans.zh: 了解，每張發票我都會請店家打公司的統編。
ans.py: Liǎojiě, měi zhāng fāpiào wǒ dōu huì qǐng diànjiā dǎ gōngsī de tǒngbiān.
ans.en: Understood — I'll have every shop print the company tax ID on the invoice.

them.zh: 很好！號碼我傳給你。回來以後呢？知道要做什麼嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo! Hàomǎ wǒ chuán gěi nǐ. Huílái yǐhòu ne? Zhīdào yào zuò shénme ma?
them.en: Perfect! I'll send you the number. And after you're back — know what to do?

turns.task: Fill out the itemized expense list within a week and attach all receipts.

ans.zh: 一週內填好費用明細，把收據都附上。
ans.py: Yì zhōu nèi tián hǎo fèiyòng míngxì, bǎ shōujù dōu fù shàng.
ans.en: Fill out the itemized list within a week and attach all the receipts.

them.zh: 滿分！明細我核准了就送會計，月底前錢就下來了。
them.py: Mǎnfēn! Míngxì wǒ hézhǔn le jiù sòng kuàijì, yuèdǐ qián qián jiù xiàlái le.
them.en: Full marks! Once I approve it, it goes to accounting — money lands before month's end.

turns.task: Ask a real-world question: what if a night-market stall can't give an invoice?

ans.zh: 請教一下，如果夜市的攤子開不了發票，怎麼辦？
ans.py: Qǐngjiào yíxià, rúguǒ yèshì de tānzi kāi bù liǎo fāpiào, zěnme bàn?
ans.en: One question — what if a night-market stall can't issue an invoice?

them.zh: 好問題！用收據代替，寫清楚店名跟金額，我這邊可以核准。
them.py: Hǎo wèntí! Yòng shōujù dàitì, xiě qīngchǔ diànmíng gēn jīn'é, wǒ zhè biān kěyǐ hézhǔn.
them.en: Good question! A receipt works instead — clear shop name and amount, and I can approve it.

turns.task: Thank her — with her rules, this will be your cleanest expense report ever.

ans.zh: 謝謝小美！照你的規定來，這次一定是我最乾淨的一次報帳！
ans.py: Xièxiè Xiǎoměi! Zhào nǐ de guīdìng lái, zhè cì yídìng shì wǒ zuì gānjìng de yí cì bàozhàng!
ans.en: Thanks, Xiaomei! Following your rules, this'll be my cleanest expense report ever!

scenarios.intro: Two weeks to the signing. The boss wants the MOU framed before the lawyers polish it. Bring structure: rights, benefits, scope.

them.zh: 簽約前，對方希望先簽一份備忘錄。你怎麼看？
them.py: Qiānyuē qián, duìfāng xīwàng xiān qiān yí fèn bèiwànglù. Nǐ zěnme kàn?
them.en: Before the signing, they want an MOU first. Your take?

turns.task: Support it — an MOU isn't the formal contract, but it gives negotiations direction.

ans.zh: 我贊成。備忘錄雖然不是正式合約，但是能讓談判更有方向。
ans.py: Wǒ zànchéng. Bèiwànglù suīrán bú shì zhèngshì héyuē, dànshì néng ràng tánpàn gèng yǒu fāngxiàng.
ans.en: I'm for it. An MOU isn't the formal contract, but it gives the negotiations direction.

them.zh: 內容你會怎麼安排？
them.py: Nèiróng nǐ huì zěnme ānpái?
them.en: How would you structure the content?

turns.task: Three parts: both sides' rights and interests, expected benefits, and the scope of future cooperation.

ans.zh: 分三個部分：雙方的權益、預期的效益，還有未來合作的範圍。
ans.py: Fēn sān ge bùfèn: shuāngfāng de quányì, yùqí de xiàoyì, háiyǒu wèilái hézuò de fànwéi.
ans.en: Three parts: both sides' rights and interests, expected benefits, and the scope of future cooperation.

them.zh: 對方想把增加投資也寫進去，我們要注意什麼？
them.py: Duìfāng xiǎng bǎ zēngjiā tóuzī yě xiě jìnqù, wǒmen yào zhùyì shénme?
them.en: They want the added investment written in too — what do we watch for?

turns.task: Regarding the investment: welcome it, but rights and scope must be clarified first, or the contract talks get complicated.

ans.zh: 針對投資，我們歡迎，但是權益跟範圍要先談清楚，不然合約的談判會變得很複雜。
ans.py: Zhēnduì tóuzī, wǒmen huānyíng, dànshì quányì gēn fànwéi yào xiān tán qīngchǔ, bùrán héyuē de tánpàn huì biàn de hěn fùzá.
ans.en: On the investment — we welcome it, but rights and scope must be clarified first, or the contract negotiations turn complicated.

them.zh: 有道理。效益的部分，數字要寫多具體？
them.py: Yǒu dàolǐ. Xiàoyì de bùfèn, shùzì yào xiě duō jùtǐ?
them.en: Fair. On benefits — how specific should the numbers be?

turns.task: Directional, not binding — expected ranges, since the MOU shouldn't lock in figures the contract will negotiate.

ans.zh: 寫方向就好，用預期的範圍，不要把數字寫死，那是合約要談的。
ans.py: Xiě fāngxiàng jiù hǎo, yòng yùqí de fànwéi, búyào bǎ shùzì xiě sǐ, nà shì héyuē yào tán de.
ans.en: Directional only — expected ranges. Don't lock the numbers in; that's for the contract to negotiate.

them.zh: 很成熟的想法。最後，這份備忘錄的精神是什麼？
them.py: Hěn chéngshú de xiǎngfǎ. Zuìhòu, zhè fèn bèiwànglù de jīngshén shì shénme?
them.en: Mature thinking. Last — what's the spirit of this MOU?

turns.task: One word: win-win — a partnership that goes long and steady.

ans.zh: 兩個字：雙贏。讓這個合作走得長、走得穩。
ans.py: Liǎng ge zì: shuāngyíng. Ràng zhège hézuò zǒu de cháng, zǒu de wěn.
ans.en: Two characters: win-win. A partnership that goes long and goes steady.

x: 牙刷跟牙膏都放進去了。
Yáshuā gēn yágāo dōu fàng jìnqù le.
The toothbrush and toothpaste are packed.
vocab.n: 牙 tooth + 刷 brush. 刷牙 = to brush teeth — same characters, flipped: noun 牙刷, verb 刷牙.

x: 我的牙膏快用完了。
Wǒ de yágāo kuài yòng wán le.
My toothpaste is almost used up.
vocab.n: 膏 paste/cream shows up all over the pharmacy: 藥膏 ointment, 護唇膏 lip balm.

x: 幫我拿一條毛巾。
Bāng wǒ ná yì tiáo máojīn.
Grab me a towel.
vocab.n: Measure word 條. Family: 浴巾 bath towel, 紙巾 paper napkin, 圍巾 scarf — 巾 is anything cloth-and-flat.

x: 行李箱不大，可是放得下。
Xínglǐxiāng bú dà, kěshì fàng de xià.
The suitcase isn't big, but it all fits.
vocab.n: 行李 luggage + 箱 box (same 箱 as 冰箱!). 登機箱 = carry-on — the airport upgrade word.

x: 先買車票，再訂房。
Xiān mǎi chēpiào, zài dìngfáng.
Tickets first, then book the room.
vocab.n: Same 訂 as 訂位: 訂房 rooms, 訂位 tables/seats, 訂票 tickets. 訂房網站 = booking sites.

x: 我們訂一間雙人房。
Wǒmen dìng yì jiān shuāngrénfáng.
We're booking a double room.
vocab.n: 雙人 two-person + 房. 單人房 single, 兩張單人床 = twin beds — specify, or roll the dice on one big bed.

x: 車票很快就買好了。
Chēpiào hěn kuài jiù mǎi hǎo le.
The tickets were bought in no time.
vocab.n: 票 stacks onto everything: 機票 flight, 門票 admission, 發票 invoice. 買票/訂票/取票 buy/book/collect.

x: 我要買兩張高鐵的來回票。
Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng zhāng gāotiě de láihuípiào.
Two round-trip HSR tickets, please.
vocab.n: 來回 come-and-return + 票. Opposite: 單程票 one-way. 來回 alone works too: 台北高雄來回 Taipei–Kaohsiung round trip.

x: 行李可以先放櫃檯。
Xínglǐ kěyǐ xiān fàng guìtái.
You can leave luggage at the front desk.
vocab.n: Hotels, banks, airports — anywhere with service staff behind a counter. 櫃檯人員 desk staff; 報到櫃檯 check-in counter.

x: 今天可以免費幫您升等。
Jīntiān kěyǐ miǎnfèi bāng nín shēngděng.
We can upgrade you free today.
vocab.n: 升 rise + 等 grade: rooms, flight seats, memberships. 免費升等 = the two sweetest words in travel.

x: 連假的高鐵票要用搶的。
Liánjià de gāotiě piào yào yòng qiǎng de.
Holiday HSR tickets are a fastest-finger fight.
vocab.n: Same 搶 as 搶修/搶購 — racing the clock. 用搶的 'obtained by grabbing' is the set phrase for anything that sells out in minutes.

x: 我要靠窗的位子。
Wǒ yào kàochuāng de wèizi.
I'd like a window seat.
vocab.n: 靠 lean against + 窗. Opposite: 靠走道 aisle. Works for trains, planes, and the cafe table with the view.

x: 這些費用都可以報帳。
Zhèxiē fèiyòng dōu kěyǐ bàozhàng.
These costs can all be expensed.
vocab.n: 報 report + 帳 account. The verb of every business trip's aftermath. 報公帳 = put it on the company.

x: 發票要打公司的統編。
Fāpiào yào dǎ gōngsī de tǒngbiān.
Print the company tax ID on the invoice.
vocab.n: Short for 統一編號 — the 8-digit company ID. 要打統編嗎？ asks every Taiwan cashier. Say yes on business trips or accounting cries.

x: 請先看差旅的規定。
Qǐng xiān kàn chāilǚ de guīdìng.
Please review the business-travel regulations.
vocab.n: 出差 + 旅行 compressed: 差旅費 travel expenses, 差旅規定 travel policy. Note the reading — chāi here, not chà.

x: 回來一週內要填費用明細。
Huílái yì zhōu nèi yào tián fèiyòng míngxì.
File the itemized expenses within a week of returning.
vocab.n: 明 clear + 細 fine-grained: 費用明細 expense breakdown, 交易明細 transaction history — the line-by-line receipts of adult life.

x: 雙方決定先簽一份備忘錄。
Shuāngfāng juédìng xiān qiān yí fèn bèiwànglù.
Both sides decided to sign a memorandum first.
vocab.n: 備忘 guard-against-forgetting + 錄 record. 合作備忘錄 = MOU, the handshake-on-paper before the contract. Also just 'memo' in offices.

x: 備忘錄要先確認雙方的權益。
Bèiwànglù yào xiān quèrèn shuāngfāng de quányì.
The MOU first confirms both sides' rights and interests.
vocab.n: 權 rights + 益 benefits: 消費者權益 consumer rights, 保障權益 protect one's interests — contract-page and news-page regular.

x: 預期的效益要寫清楚。
Yùqí de xiàoyì yào xiě qīngchǔ.
The expected benefits must be written clearly.
vocab.n: 效 effect + 益 gain: 經濟效益 economic benefit, 成本效益 cost-effectiveness. The number-flavored cousin of 好處.

x: 我們的目標是創造雙贏。
Wǒmen de mùbiāo shì chuàngzào shuāngyíng.
Our goal is to create a win-win.
vocab.n: 雙 double + 贏 win: 創造雙贏 create a win-win, 雙贏局面 win-win situation. Negotiation-speak's north star; triple version 三贏 exists too.

slang.e: a dud, a landmine — bad and to be avoided
x: 那家飯店超雷，照片跟房間完全不一樣。
Nà jiā fàndiàn chāo léi, zhàopiàn gēn fángjiān wánquán bù yíyàng.
That hotel is a total landmine — the photos and the room are nothing alike.
slang.n: From 地雷 landmine: a bad restaurant, hotel, movie, teammate. 踩雷 = stepped on one; 排雷 = scouting so others don't. Review-site vocabulary.

x: 會叫櫃檯免費升等，你很巷子內喔！
Huì jiào guìtái miǎnfèi shēngděng, nǐ hěn xiàngzi nèi ō!
Scoring a free desk upgrade? You're a real insider!
slang.n: Hokkien 'inside the alley': where locals actually go. 巷子內的人 knows the unlisted menu. Compliment for street-smart expertise.

x: 含早餐還免費升等，這家飯店真的很佛心。
Hán zǎocān hái miǎnfèi shēngděng, zhè jiā fàndiàn zhēn de hěn fóxīn.
Breakfast included AND a free upgrade — this hotel is saintly.
slang.n: 佛 Buddha + 心 heart: kindness beyond market logic. 佛心價 mercy pricing, 佛心公司 a company that treats people too well.

x: 這家麵攤又便宜又好吃，根本撿到寶！
Zhè jiā miàntān yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, gēnběn jiǎndào bǎo!
This noodle stall is cheap AND delicious — total hidden gem!
slang.n: 撿 pick up + 寶 treasure: finding value everyone else missed — a stall, a deal, a hire. 撿到寶了！ = jackpot!

slang.e: buying it IS profiting — a steal
x: 來回票加飯店才三千，買到賺到！
Láihuípiào jiā fàndiàn cái sānqiān, mǎidào zhuàndào!
Round-trip tickets plus hotel for three thousand — an absolute steal!
slang.n: The night-market hawker's chant: buy it and you've already won. Deploy for any deal so good it feels like arbitrage.
